    About Chigaroo

    Chigaroo is a big collection of small offline games. New games will keep being added to this same list, and the existing games will stay right where they are.

    Version: 1.0

    Privacy Policy

    1. What data we collect

    Chigaroo's games run offline. Your game scores and progress stay on your phone. Playing the games collects no player name or phone number, and we do not collect your location.

    If you are a developer and use "Add Your Game", the name, WhatsApp number, email address and game details you type in are sent to the owner via WhatsApp — but only when you tap the "Send via WhatsApp" button — so the owner can review your listing. Nothing is collected or sent automatically.

    2. Ads

    The free version may show small ads served by an ad network. When you take Premium (Monthly or Yearly), the ads are switched off.

    3. Subscription

    Subscription payments are handled by Google Play Billing. Your payment details (such as your card) never come to us — they stay with Google.

    4. Children's privacy

    The games are for all ages. We do not knowingly collect children's personal data.

    5. Contact

    If you have any question about privacy, contact the app's owner — contact details will be given in the final version.

    Terms & Conditions

    1. Using the app

    Chigaroo is for entertainment only. All games are offline, and there is no system for winning or losing real money — no betting or gambling.

    2. Premium subscription

    The Monthly plan costs Rs 99 per month and the Yearly plan costs Rs 499 per year. Both plans switch off the ads. You can cancel your subscription anytime from Google Play; after cancelling, Premium stays active until the end of the current period.

    3. Content

    The games and their pictures are the property of Chigaroo. Copying them without permission is not allowed.

    4. Changes

    New games will be added over time. A game may also be removed. If these terms change, it will be announced in the app.

    5. Games from other developers

    Developers can submit their own games through "Add Your Game". A submitted game is listed only after the owner has reviewed and approved it, and a listing fee may apply. The developer keeps full ownership of their game.

    Add Your Game

    For game developers — get your own game listed in Chigaroo

    Made a small game of your own? You can get it listed in Chigaroo for a listing fee. Fill in the form below — the owner checks every game first, and your game appears in the games list only after it is approved.

    How it works

    1. Fill in the form below with your game details.
    2. The owner reviews your game — it must work fully offline and follow the game rules below.
    3. Pay the listing fee — the fee is arranged with the owner outside the app (for example on WhatsApp). No payment is taken inside the app.
    4. Once your game is approved, it appears in the Chigaroo games list.

    Contact Chigaroo

    Send your game files, or ask any question about listing your game, on WhatsApp or by email:

    WhatsApp0335-2710980 › Emailwadoodalizai@gmail.com ›
    Listing fee: Rs 499, one-time. The fee is arranged with the owner outside the app (for example on WhatsApp). No payment is taken inside the app.

    What you need to send

    • Your game's name, picture/icon, a short description, and its category
    • Your game files — an HTML5 web version works best inside the app
    • A written confirmation that the game is your own work, not copied from someone else
    • Confirmation that your game works fully offline
    • Your name, WhatsApp number, and email address, plus your payment details in case a refund is ever needed

    Game rules

    • No betting, gambling, or winning and losing real money
    • No adult or inappropriate content — the game must be safe for all ages
    • The game must run offline, and stay small and fast
    • No ads of your own — your game must not show its own ads. Only Chigaroo's ads will be shown in your game
    • You will not be paid for ads — you pay the listing fee to get your game listed in Chigaroo

    Submission form

    * All fields are required — you must fill in every field.

    Ads rule: Your game must not have its own ads — only Chigaroo's ads will be shown in your game. You will not be paid for those ads; you pay the listing fee to get listed.

    By sending this form, you confirm that the game is your own work, that it has no ads of its own, and that it follows the game rules above.
